title: Alignment Pretraining: AI Discourse Causes Self-Fulfilling (Mis)alignment
reasoning: The paper benchmarks AI alignment and behavioral propensities using scenario-based evaluations derived from the 'Introduction to AI Safety, Ethics, and Society' textbook. It also evaluates models on Dark Triad personality traits (Machiavellianism, Narcissism, and Psychopathy) to measure moral and character-based dispositions.
